notes.title: Festival update
notes.notes:
Recently, a system for creating items has been added, the initial tasks have been updated, which will allow you to immerse yourself in the world of Neverseas easier and more enjoyable, as well as a world-building system and much more. Our main goal with this update is to simplify controls, as well as provide you with more tips on how to control and interact with our game world. Separately, on behalf of the studio, we would like to express our gratitude to all the players who provided feedback through our Discord or video on Youtube.

[hr][/hr]

We have also made content updates to the current version of the game.

[table noborder=1]
    [tr]
        [td style="width: 30"] 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021039/be0f174c52a7222459856f6dcccd51e4a87655f5.png 
        [/td]
        [td] Added item creation system. Now you can create materials and equipment that will help you in battles with opponents both at sea and on land.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td] 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021039/7c37a43c33b7d6cf587e4f85dcada17e526abe09.png
        [/td]
        [td] Добавлен новый корабельный модуль - Корабельная Сеть. В различных ее вариациях она сможет Вам помочь с восполнением ресурсов для команды или со сбором ресурсов для крафта.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td] 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021039/fdfcfc491ef29cd171dd5d20f147e96770d3c150.png
        [/td]
        [td] Added a new ship module - Ship Network. In its various variations, it can help you with replenishing resources for the team or collecting resources for crafting.[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td] 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45021039/67161d65e1d82688ec8af3f3156df17d5d32f52f.png
        [/td]
        [td] Additional tasks have been added in the form of orders that can be given to you by merchants and island residents.[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table] 

[hr][/hr]

And thanks to your feedback, some changes have been made to existing systems

 The interface of the store window has been redesigned.
 Interaction options have been improved, so you no longer have to choose between picking up an item or talking to an island resident.
 The sight on the ship has been changed. Now at night it is visible more clearly and brightly.
 Added many control hints or hints to various systems.
 The game settings have been completed. Now all the sliders and checkboxes in the settings work correctly!
 The localization work is almost complete.
 And many other small changes that we hope will make the game more convenient and enjoyable.


Good luck in your new campaigns Captain!
